jobs.title: Project Manager, Implementation
jobs.description:
Are you seeking an exciting opportunity to join a passionate, growing, and dynamic team of professionals who support patients?


The Project Manager II, Implementation, is responsible for leading the successful implementation of Knowtion Health programs at client health systems. This role oversees all aspects of project execution, including planning, documentation, communication, and risk management, to ensure timely delivery and alignment with client expectations and organizational standards.


**What’s Attractive to the Right Candidate?**


* Knowtion Health is a growing firm in a growing industry. Our status as a leader in this industry means that we have the resources to invest in the business and to innovate.
* Our business is intensely competitive and is constantly evolving. We quickly identify new challenges and develop solutions, so you won’t simply be doing what was done last year. Our new employees are frequently pleased and surprised by how quickly we make decisions and adapt to market conditions.
* Knowtion Health culture is inviting and competitive, embracing challenge and celebrating accomplishment; dedicated colleagues striving to provide quality results that have lasting impact.


**The Opportunity:**


* Develop and manage comprehensive project plans aligned with client requirements and contractual statements of work.
* Lead multiple concurrent client implementation projects, ensuring timely progress and clear communication across internal and external stakeholders.
* Monitor project milestones and task completion, proactively identifying risks and implementing mitigation strategies.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, stakeholders, and internal teams to position Knowtion Health as a trusted partner.
* Track program success against booking estimates and report on key performance indicators.


**What you bring:**


* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience.
* 2\+ years working for a healthcare or revenue cycle organization
* 3\+ years in client\-facing, technology\-driven implementation or project management roles.


The above statements are intended to provide the general nature and level of work being performed by most people assigned to the position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and requirements.


This position is remote and requires a dedicated, distraction\-free work space at home. We offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short term disability, long term disability, paid holidays, 401k, and a generous PTO policy.


Knowtion Health gives priority to applicants located in the following states: AL, AR, AZ, FL, GA, ID, IN, KS, ME, MI, MO, MS, NC, NM, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WI, WV


**Photo Identification and Image Capture Notice**


As part of our hiring process, candidates are required to present a valid government\-issued photo ID during screening and/or interviews.


We may also capture a photograph during the screening or interview process for identity verification, security, and record\-keeping purposes. All identification documents and images will be handled in accordance with applicable privacy laws and accessed only by authorized personnel.


By proceeding with your application, you acknowledge and consent to this process.

jobs.title: Vendor Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Title**
=============


Vendor Onboarding Specialist**Job Description Summary**
===========================


C\&W Services is seeking a Vendor Onboarding Specialist to support a high\-priority initiative for one of our large clients. This role will focus heavily on vendor sourcing, research, outreach, and onboarding, while also supporting contract management and compliance functions within our Facilities Hub. Candidates should be highly detail\-oriented, self\-motivated, have great phone skills and be comfortable using online tools to execute a defined process efficiently.  

This is an ideal opportunity for professionals with experience in customer service, vendor management, or administrative coordination who can thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**

**Vendor Research, Outreach \& Onboarding (Primary Focus):**

* Source and research service providers using Google Maps, search engines, or AI tools (e.g. Copilot) based on project needs and locations.
* Log potential vendors into standardized trackers with accurate contact and service area data.
* Conduct direct outreach to vendors via phone and email to explain subcontractor opportunities.
* Guide interested vendors through the onboarding process, including documentation, answering questions, and uploading files to internal systems.
* Identify which locations each vendor can service and track accordingly.
* Provide status updates and flag onboarding completions to the internal team.
* High\-volume outbound calling capability (40–60 calls per day target)
* Explain program value, overcome hesitation, and secure commitments
* Follow\-through with urgency to move vendors to completion

**Vendor Compliance \& Contract Administration (Secondary Support):**

* Support internal vendor compliance efforts to ensure alignment with client and company standards.
* Educate new and existing vendors on compliance and performance expectations.
* May be asked to assist in issuing vendor agreements and amendments in coordination with Legal and Risk Management teams.
* Submit and track Internal Change Forms for accurate record\-keeping (SOX compliant).
* Maintain databases and spreadsheets to track contract documentation, compliance materials, and onboarding progress.

**Qualifications**

**Required (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Experience):**

* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
* Minimum 3 years in a role that involves:
* High\-volume phone\-based outreach (call center, inside sales, account development, vendor management, or dispatch environments preferred)
* Convincing/persuading external parties.
* Managing structured onboarding/compliance tasks (e.g., contracts, insurance verification, licensing, or regulated documentation)
* Comfortable working in a metric\-driven environment with recorded calls \& performance tracking
* Detail\-oriented enough to validate insurance \& compliance requirements
* Competent with spreadsheet tracking and structured workflow processes
* Experience working with contractors, service providers, trades, or vendors strongly preferred

**Remote Work Requirements**

* High‑speed internet (150\-300 mbps. download) is required for this role. Connection must support video meetings, remote system access, consistent productivity, with uninterrupted workflow**.**
* Employees must have a quiet, distraction‑free workspace suitable for professional phone conversations and to protect customer information.
* Camera‑on participation is required during meetings and trainings, as we operate in a fully virtual environment and rely on video presence for collaboration, engagement, and team connection.
* The workspace must be able to accommodate multiple screens and provide an ergonomic setup that supports productivity.
* To maintain business continuity, employees are expected to have a backup plan for connectivity disruptions, including access to an alternate location (such as a co‑working space, library, or other reliable environment) in case of home internet or power loss.

**Preferred**

* Phone sales experience
* Experience supporting facilities, maintenance, or service‑based operations
* High attention to detail and strong organizational skills
* 3–5 years of professional experience in administrative support, customer service, recruiting, or vendor management preferred
* Comfortable using Microsoft Office (especially Excel and Word), online research tools, and AI\-enabled platforms preferred
* Strong ability to follow structured processes and escalate appropriately when needed
* Able to multitask in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment
* Self\-directed with the ability to work independently and with a team
* Willingness to learn new technologies and support evolving business needs

**Key Competencies \& Traits**

* Calm, composed, and decisive in high‑urgency situations
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Highly organized with strong time‑management skills
* Collaborative and adaptable across teams and systems
* Comfortable working in a metric driven environment

  


Cushman \& Wakefield also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health, vision, and dental insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life, and disability insurance programs, and paid and unpaid time away from work. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, Cushman and Wakefield provide eligible employees with competitive pay, which may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, total hours worked, job type, business line, and applicability of collective bargaining agreements.  


The compensation that will be offered to the successful candidate will depend on factors such as whether the position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement, the geographic area in which the work will be performed, market pay rates in that area, and the candidate’s experience and qualifications.  


The company will not pay less than minimum wage for this role.  


The compensation for the position is: $22\.10 \- $26\.00
C\&W Services is an Equal Opportunity employer to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Discrimination of any type will not be tolerated.


In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act Amendments Act (ADAAA), if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation in order to apply for a position at C\&W Services, please call the ADA line at **1\-888\-365\-5406** or email Accommodations@cushwake.com. Please refer to the job title and job location when you contact us.

jobs.title: Clinical Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Knowtex.ai**

**Clinical Implementation Specialist**

 **LOCATION**


Remote (US)

**TRAVEL**


20–30%, federal and commercial sites

**REPORTS TO**


Director of Customer Delivery

**LICENSE**


RN, NP, PA, PharmD, or equivalent

**SCHEDULE**


Core business hours, with flexibility across time zones

  

**About** **Knowtex.ai**
========================


Knowtex is transforming healthcare documentation through ambient AI scribe technology that allows clinicians to focus on patients instead of computers. Our platform uses advanced AI to convert natural clinical conversations into accurate, comprehensive medical documentation — reducing clinician burnout while improving care quality.


We're scaling rapidly across both the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and a growing base of commercial health systems — two very different operating environments with one shared bar: the note has to be safe, complete, and trustworthy, every time, for every clinician who depends on it in real time.

**The Opportunity**
===================


We're at a critical inflection point. Over the next 90 days, this role will drive massive scaling across our federal and commercial portfolios.


We need a Clinical Implementation Specialist who is equal parts clinician, implementation scientist, and clinical informaticist — someone who can stand in front of a room of skeptical physicians one hour and sit inside an AI prompt the next, tracing a clinician's error report back to its root cause. You'll be the clinical voice our users trust, and the clinical judgment behind how our AI is tuned, turning what you hear on the front line into documentation that's safe, complete, and trusted by the providers who sign it.


Day to day, that means onboarding new sites and clinicians, running training, building the clinical champion network that makes adoption durable rather than a one\-time launch event, and leading recovery at sites that are struggling. You'll do this one clinician at a time and at scale, often in the same week: coaching a new user through their first generated note, and building the curriculum and playbook that carry that result everywhere else.


This role reports to the Director of Customer Delivery and works in daily partnership with the rest of Customer Delivery, and directly with Engineering (including the Technical Product Manager and on\-call engineers) to close the loop between what clinicians experience and what the product does.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Onboarding, Training Delivery \& Coaching 30%**
-------------------------------------------------

* Conduct live virtual training sessions for clinicians across all specialties and both federal and commercial sites (physicians, NPs, PAs, pharmacists, mental health providers)
* Present at approved provider and leadership staff meetings to provide platform updates, training, and support
* Lead virtual office hours and recurring Q\&A sessions providing just\-in\-time workflow support to users at every stage, from brand\-new to long\-tenured
* Onboard and coach new users individually through early activation, adapting your approach to specialty, technical comfort, and sector (federal vs. commercial)
* Deliver train\-the\-trainer sessions to build capacity among Site POCs and Clinical Champions
* Track training attendance, completion, satisfaction, and time\-to\-activation; feed findings back into training content and coaching approach

**Training \& Educational Materials 15%**
-----------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain training curriculum, job aids, and education resources for both federal and commercial audiences, including specialty\-specific modules
* Update materials continuously based on product changes, user feedback, and clinical best practice — this is a living library, not a one\-time build
* Design self\-paced and asynchronous resources so coaching capacity scales with user volume rather than growing linearly with it
* Develop release communication for feature updates and product changes — external materials for users, and internal briefings that prepare Customer Support and Implementation before rollout

**Clinical Champion Network 10%**
---------------------------------

* Identify Clinical Champions through both adoption data and relationships built in the field, then recruit and develop them to extend adoption support within their own facilities
* Build and facilitate an active Clinical Champion community of practice — peer learning, shared best practices, and a channel that surfaces problems early
* Sustain engagement over time, not just at launch; a champion network that goes quiet within a quarter isn't doing its job

**Implementation Strategy \& Service Recovery 20%**
---------------------------------------------------

* Develop and execute implementation strategy for new and scaling sites across both sectors
* Diagnose and lead service recovery for sites in one of two distinct situations — initial adoption struggles (never really got going) and negative first\-experience recovery (tried it, had a bad early experience, and are now skeptical or vocal) — and tailor your intervention to which one you're facing
* Conduct workflow assessments to identify integration opportunities and barriers, and translate findings into a concrete site\-level plan
* Identify patterns across sites — the failure modes that repeat, the interventions that consistently work — and document them in the implementation playbook so the next site starts ahead of where the last one did

**AI Prompt Judgment \& Clinical Quality 20%**
----------------------------------------------

* Build and maintain deep product understanding — how the AI generates notes, where prompts and templates drive behavior, and where the boundaries of the model's clinical judgment are
* Interpret clinician\-reported concerns and errors (missing findings, fabricated content, incorrect clinical reasoning) and perform root cause analysis to distinguish a prompt issue from a workflow issue from a genuine model limitation
* Recommend prompt changes and carry them through implementation, grounded in clinical judgment, safety, and quality standards — with the sole aim of keeping note output safe, complete, and aligned with provider expectations
* Escalate patient safety concerns immediately per protocol; no finding sits unreviewed
* Partner on the Clinical Quality Scoring Rubric and documentation audit findings where they intersect with training or prompt behavior

**Cross\-Functional Partnership with Engineering 5%**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Work directly with the Technical Product Manager and on\-call engineers to resolve live, customer\-facing issues in real time
* Serve as the trusted clinical voice inside product and engineering discussions — translating a clinician's frustration into a specific, actionable problem statement and making the clinical case for prioritization
* Contribute to longer\-term product and feature discussions informed by frontline patterns, not just individual tickets

**Who You Are**
===============

**CLINICAL BACKGROUND**

* Active clinical license (RN, NP, PA, PharmD, or equivalent) with 5\+ years of direct patient care experience
* Understanding of clinical documentation requirements, EHR workflows, and medical decision\-making across specialties
* Comfort operating in both federal (VA) and commercial healthcare environments — or a credible plan for ramping into whichever side is less familiar
* Understanding of HIPAA, medical\-legal documentation standards, and quality requirements

**IMPLEMENTATION SCIENCE, INFORMATICS \& AI**

* Experience with implementation science frameworks (RE\-AIM, CFIR) or equivalent structured approaches to adoption and change management
* Demonstrated ability to conduct root cause analysis (5 Whys, fishbone, or equivalent) on a clinical, workflow, or quality problem
* Direct or adjacent experience with AI/NLP prompt design, prompt evaluation, or clinical documentation improvement technologies — you don't need to have built models, but you need to be comfortable reasoning about how a prompt change would or wouldn't fix a reported error
* Comfort working from product analytics and dashboards to identify patterns, not just anecdotes

**TRAINING \& EDUCATION**

* 3\+ years developing and delivering clinical education or healthcare IT training
* Demonstrated ability to build effective curriculum and measure its impact beyond satisfaction scores (retention, behavior change, time\-to\-activation)
* Experience with virtual training platforms and comfort presenting to groups from 5 to 100\+
* Track record adapting delivery across specialties and audiences with different technical proficiency

**COMMUNICATION \& JUDGMENT**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication; able to earn a skeptical clinician's trust quickly
* Strong collaborator across internal teams, with the credibility to advocate for clinical needs in technical discussions
* Comfortable delivering an executive briefing on short notice, then answering a support ticket an hour later — this role moves fluidly between strategic and hands\-on work
* Sound clinical and ethical judgment under time pressure, particularly around patient safety escalation

**MINDSET**

* Entrepreneurial, comfortable with ambiguity, and willing to pick up work that doesn't have an obvious owner
* Genuinely mission\-driven — motivated by what's at stake when the technology in question touches real\-time clinical care, not just another SaaS rollout
* Sees Engineering, Product, and the rest of Customer Delivery as partners, not separate lanes — inclined to bring people in early instead of arriving with a finished answer

**Strongly preferred**

* Master's degree in Nursing, Health Administration, Public Health, Medical Education, Clinical Informatics, or related field
* Experience with ambient AI, clinical documentation improvement, or speech recognition technologies
* Prior experience in a startup or fast\-scaling environment where role boundaries were fluid
* VA clinical experience (staff clinician, clinical educator, or clinical informaticist) and commercial health system experience
* Section 508 accessibility compliance experience

**Key Collaborations**
======================

**Technical Product Manager \& On\-Call Engineers**


Direct, frequent partnership resolving live customer issues and shaping prompt and product changes; primary channel for surfacing root\-caused clinician concerns

**Director of Customer Delivery**


Weekly 1:1s and strategic planning; escalation point for systemic clinical quality, safety, or training effectiveness issues

**Implementation \& Customer Support**


Daily coordination on training schedules, go\-lives, service recovery execution, and clinical quality issues surfaced through tickets

**Site POCs \& Clinical Champions (federal and commercial)**


Primary clinical contact for training, workflow guidance, and frontline advocacy

**Why Knowtex?**
================

**Mission that matters**


What's at stake here is different from a typical tech rollout — this technology sits inside real\-time clinical care, and getting it wrong has consequences a dashboard bug never would. Every barrier you remove is a clinician who gets time back and a patient whose documentation is safer and more complete.

**A true 0\-to\-1 environment**


We're fast\-paced, hands\-on, and every hat gets worn by everyone. No job is too small — you'll answer tickets and deliver executive briefings in the same week, and both matter.

**Direct impact, direct influence**


You'll work hands\-on with frontline clinicians and directly with the engineers who build the product you rely on. Your root\-cause findings and prompt recommendations shape what ships next.

**Team \& culture**


A tight, cross\-functional team that treats the customer's voice — and the clinician's safety — as the center of gravity for every decision.

**Logistics**
=============

**LOCATION**


Remote, with travel required to federal and commercial sites for workflow assessments, go\-lives, service recovery visits, and training events (estimated 20–30%, adjusted to implementation needs)

**REPORTS TO**


Director of Customer Delivery

**SCHEDULE**


Core business hours with flexibility for training delivery across time zones and both federal and commercial calendars

**COMPENSATION**


Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus equity, comprehensive benefits, and professional development opportunities **.**

**To Apply**


We're looking for a clinician\-informaticist who loves teaching, thinks in root causes, and wants to shape how AI shows up safely in real clinical practice — across both federal and commercial healthcare. Please submit your resume and a cover letter addressing:

* Why a role spanning clinical practice, implementation science, and AI prompting excites you
* An example of diagnosing a clinical or workflow problem down to its root cause, and what you changed as a result
* Your approach to service recovery at a site that's either never adopted well or had a bad first experience


Knowtex.ai is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse team that reflects the clinicians and patients we serve.


Compensation Range: $110K \- $180K

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist (Banking Technology & Core Conversions)
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**


The **Implementation Specialist** is responsible for supporting the successful planning, installation, configuration, testing, conversion, and implementation of CSI's NuPoint core banking solutions and related technologies. This role serves as a key liaison between customers, core providers, vendors, and internal CSI teams to ensure implementations are completed accurately, on schedule, and with a high level of customer satisfaction. The position combines customer\-facing project coordination responsibilities with hands\-on technical implementation work. The Implementation Specialist assists with software deployments, data conversions, user setup, troubleshooting, testing, training, and go\-live activities while helping customers successfully transition to CSI solutions.

 **What You'll Do**

**Customer Communication \& Project Coordination**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned implementation projects.
* Communicate effectively with bank leadership, end users, vendors, core providers, and internal CSI teams.
* Coordinate implementation activities, project milestones, and customer expectations throughout the conversion process.
* Gather and document customer requirements and project information.
* Communicate project risks, status updates, and implementation recommendations to appropriate stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships with customers and internal business partners.
* Coordinate resources and escalate issues when additional expertise is required.

**Data Conversion \& Implementation Support**

* Coordinate with financial institutions and their existing core providers to obtain customer data files required for conversion and testing.
* Download, transfer, and distribute customer files using FTP and other secure file\-transfer methods.
* Track conversion deliverables and ensure required files are received on schedule.
* Support customer conversion planning, preparation, execution, and validation activities.
* Configure test\-bank environments to support customer testing and validation.
* Set up users, permissions, and system access in both testing and production environments.
* Identify, document, and escalate conversion issues requiring additional review.

**Software Installation \& Configuration**

* Install, configure, and support NuPoint software and related ancillary applications.
* Assist with hardware, workstation, and peripheral installations at customer locations.
* Configure software, system settings, and application environments according to project requirements.
* Validate hardware and software functionality prior to customer testing and production conversion.
* Coordinate implementation activities with engineering, support, and infrastructure teams.
* Maintain knowledge of CSI products, implementation processes, and technology solutions.

**Troubleshooting \& Technical Support**

* Troubleshoot workstation, application, connectivity, hardware, and software issues during implementations and conversions.
* Perform first\-level issue triage and determine appropriate resolution paths.
* Work with NetOps, SecOps, Managed Services, customer IT teams, and third\-party vendors to resolve technical issues.
* Support customers during testing, conversion weekends, and go\-live activities.
* Escalate unresolved issues to appropriate technical teams while maintaining customer communication.
* Assist in maintaining stable customer environments throughout implementation activities.

**Training \& Go\-Live Support**

* Guide customers through testing and validation activities.
* Deliver training and knowledge\-transfer sessions to end users and customer stakeholders.
* Support implementation, go\-live, hyper\-care, and transition activities.
* Provide initial post\-conversion support and assist with issue resolution.
* Coordinate successful transitions to CSI support teams following implementation completion.
* Help ensure customers are fully prepared to operate their new environment successfully.

**Documentation \& Project Delivery**

* Maintain implementation documentation, configuration records, testing results, and project notes.
* Document completed work, technical changes, issues, resolutions, and customer requirements.
* Support project schedules, milestones, and implementation deliverables.
* Assist in developing runbooks, knowledge\-base materials, and implementation documentation.
* Complete assigned work according to customer, project, budget, and timeline expectations.

 **What We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of 1\-2 years of relevant IT, technical support, implementation, help desk, desktop support, systems administration, or related experience.
* Associate degree, technical certification, trade\-school education, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Customer\-service mindset with strong relationship\-building skills.
* Demonstrated troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities.
* General knowledge of computer hardware, software, operating systems, and networking fundamentals.
* Experience installing, configuring, or supporting software applications and end\-user systems.
* Familiarity with file transfers, FTP concepts, and basic technical file management.
* Strong organization, time\-management, and project\-coordination skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to learn new technologies, products, and implementation processes.
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40\-50%.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Banking or financial institution experience.
* Core banking implementation or conversion experience.
* NuPoint experience.
* Experience supporting software implementations or technology deployments.
* Customer\-facing implementation, training, or consulting experience.
* Familiarity with data conversion, testing, and go\-live activities.
* Experience working with managed\-service providers, infrastructure teams, or customer IT organizations.

 **Travel Requirements**


Travel is expected to average approximately **40\-50%** depending on implementation schedules and customer needs. Travel generally consists of **two\-to\-five\-day customer visits** occurring several times per month and may fluctuate based on conversion activity and project demand.

  

**What Success Looks Like**


Success in this role will be measured through:

* Successful implementation and conversion outcomes.
* Customer satisfaction throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Accurate and timely completion of implementation deliverables.
* Effective troubleshooting and issue resolution.
* Strong communication with customers, vendors, and internal teams.
* Quality of implementation documentation and project records.
* Successful completion of testing and go\-live activities.
* Effective coordination of CSI resources and customer stakeholders.
* Ability to learn and grow within CSI's evolving implementation organization.


As a forward\-thinking software provider, Computer Services, Inc. (CSI) helps community and regional financial institutions solve their customers’ needs through open and flexible technologies. In addition to its award\-winning core banking platform, these include the latest in lending, digital banking, payments, financial crime prevention and cybersecurity. Building on its 60\-year track record of personalized service, CSI is shaping the future of banking and empowering its customers to rival their competition. For more information about CSI, visit www.csiweb.com


CSI provides rewarding and challenging career opportunities for our employees. When determining your pay, we consider various factors such as your skills, qualifications, experience and location. Along with a competitive salary, this position includes eligibility for incentive awards based on both individual and business performance. We also offer a comprehensive range of benefits. To learn more about our benefits, visit: Benefits Summary


CSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email us at recruiter@csiweb.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.


For applicants residing in California, please read Privacy Notice for California Residents \| CSI (csiweb.com)


Visa Sponsorship: We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or in the future.
